item.text:
Implemented `out/transform.ts`. The harness passes, along with 25 targeted tests.

Judgment calls: use Chicago recording cutoffs, apply corrections before event replay, and keep holds until explicitly changed. Reviews and billing/referral diagnoses do not update list state.

Sensitive entries and partial-date precision are preserved. CKD stages come from clinician entries; product RxNorm codes are never treated as ingredient codes.
